page.content:
Seldon's statistical science of mass human behavior.

How Psychohistory connects

  • Character: Hari Seldon — Seldon develops psychohistory as a predictive science.
  • Concept: Seldon Plan — Psychohistory is what makes the Seldon Plan calculable.

What is Psychohistory?

Psychohistory treats populations as gases: individuals vanish, but the fall of Empire and the path of recovery can be calculated if the masses stay unaware.

Key threads lead to Hari Seldon and Seldon Plan.
